## Pre-Tax

$$E[W|1]f(1) - E[W|0]f(0)=(E[W|1] - E[W|0])f(0) + E[W|1][f(1)-f(0)]$$

$$\frac{E[W|1]f(1) - E[W|0]f(0)}{E[W|0]f(0)}=\frac{E[W|1] - E[W|0]}{E[W|0]} + \frac{E[W|1][f(1)-f(0)]}{E[W|0]f(0)}$$

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

Data = read_csv("Public/Example.csv")

EY_2023 = mean(Data$Price[Data$TradeY == 2023])
EY_2021 = mean(Data$Price[Data$TradeY == 2021])
ED = mean(Data$D)

(EY_2023 - EY_2021)/EY_2021

(EY_2023/EY_2021)*((ED - 1 + ED)/(1 - ED))
```
